message: Hi, I'm a student with a python certification background. My overall academic average is 70.8% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in Management and developer. Honestly I'm not fully sure what I want to become — something in tech. My family can afford at most about USD 3400 per year. I live in Delhi. I'd strongly prefer to stay near home, though I might consider elsewhere in India.
explanation:
Keystone Technical University
This program was highly recommended because it meets your primary location preference in Delhi and keeps costs low with an annual tuition of $2050, which fits well within your budget. The minimum grade requirement of 60% is easily met by your academic background (70.8%). The main trade-off here is that while the placement rate is solid at 71%, it is not as high as some other options on this list.

Ashford University
This option was recommended due to its strong career potential, boasting a median starting salary of $13059 and an excellent placement rate of 85%. However, the annual tuition of $3350 uses up most of your maximum budget, and the minimum grade requirement (71%) is slightly higher than your current academic standing. The main trade-off is balancing this high earning potential against a significant regional move to Mumbai and a tighter budget fit.

Sarayu Institute of Technology
This program offers an excellent balance of affordability and strong career outcomes, featuring a low tuition cost of $1250 alongside a median starting salary of $13142. The placement rate is also robust at 81%, making it highly appealing for your management goals. Be aware that the minimum required grade percentage (74%) is slightly higher than your current academic score, representing the main admission hurdle.

Elmhurst School of Engineering
This program is recommended primarily because of its low cost ($1000 annual tuition) and easy admission requirements (62%), making it highly budget-friendly. It offers a good balance with a placement rate of 77% and a median starting salary of $11249. The main trade-off to consider is that the potential starting salary, while respectable, is lower compared to some other options on this list.

Longford University
This option was recommended as the most budget-friendly choice, with an annual tuition fee of only $800 and a minimum grade requirement of 64%. While it provides maximum cost savings, the main trade-off involves both location (Coimbatore) and potential salary; its median starting salary ($10444) is among the lower figures on this shortlist.
